Performers
Musopen Symphony Orchestra (orchestra) Documented

Commons names the Musopen Symphony Orchestra as the artist. The embedded Ogg metadata reads “Czech National Symphony Orchestra” as author, which the Commons page does not repeat. No conductor or individual player is credited, and the orchestra’s identity is not documented further in the pages consulted.

Composition rights
Smetana died on 12 May 1884; the composition is in the public domain. Documented

The death date is from the Bedřich Smetana Museum. This does not cover a later edition or arrangement.

[2]
Recording rights
CC0 public-domain dedication, as stated on the Commons file page. Documented

The Commons page tags the file CC0 and names Musopen as the source, whose upload terms require contributors to represent that content is in the public domain. Commons notes that Musopen’s own works are copyrighted, so the CC0 tag on the file page is the only rights statement relied on.
